sources.finding: Documents local HTTP server and explicit add-on endpoint configuration; default setup uses cloud. sources.locator: Classic offer; Use it anywhere; WordPress publishing
sources.finding: Classic Editor3 for Mac/Windows supports offline style highlighting and excludes new AI features. Optional publishing exports text. Offline availability does not establish diagnostics or retention behavior.

Web/free/Plus and Word add-in policy explicitly excludes legacy standalone desktop. Working documents normally remain in browser or Word; Plus AI sends needed text and context. Content is excluded from model training. Account/technical/usage records and optional analytics remain. Free-web and Classic claims must stay separate; no cloud document library is not no retention of every record.

Browser/device copies require user deletion. Account closure does not erase them. Technical, support and provider records have different schedules; provider exceptions preclude a blanket zero-retention claim. Scope follows the web/Word policy, not Classic.

sources.locator: Providers and roles; final scope paragraph
sources.finding: Lists feature-dependent hosting, AI, error reporting and optional analytics providers. A provider listing does not establish that it receives every user's text. The stated coverage is web and Word add-in.

Installed perpetual correction stays local. Installed subscription correction also stays local except Reformulation. Individual Web texts have an eight-hour original-text window with consent-based anonymized training retention. Account and usage information have separate handling. Text-local does not mean no account or telemetry.
